articleTitle: Comatose Patient Monitoring System Based on (IoT)
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: The Internet of Things-based monitoring system is a quickly evolving and spreading technology that is used to modernize systems to support life and society. In this work, we propose a novel health monitoring system for coma patients based on the Internet of Things (IoT) and artificial intelligence. The work is divided based on a multi-sensor system, which is applied scientifically and practically on the patient's body including a heart rate sensor, oxygen level in the blood sensor, ECG sensor, and a digital camera for monitoring the patient's eye. These sensors are connected to an embedded system, which can monitor the patient's health and provide an alarm system to notify the doctor in case of an emergency. The system is applicable and safe, also there is no need for much clinical staff or accompanying persons to be physically present inside the intensive care room to check the patient's condition when he wakes up. In the event of any sudden changes in vital health parameters, the supervising doctor will make the correct decision based on the correctness of the digital data, we got tangible results in readings of IoT sensors such as ECG sensor with 97.6% accuracy and pulse oximeter sensor with rates up to 96% SPO2 accuracy as well as 83% BMP accuracy, as well as accurate results for digital camera sensor with high accuracy of 94.9% and these Tangible results with high success rates.

articleTitle: A Practical Study of Using Fixed and Tracker Solar Systems in Mosul City
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: Solar energy is currently one of the fastest-growing types of renewable energy, with global capacity increasing significantly in recent years. The amount of energy that can be extracted from a solar panel will change with changes in directly the position of the sun. This is because the amount of sunlight that reaches the panel will vary depending on the incident angle and position of the sun in the sky. The angle of solar radiation incident is one of the most effecting factors on the productivity of photovoltaic (PV) solar panels, thus, the highest productivity of (PV) solar panels can be obtained when solar radiation incident is perpendicular to (PV)solar panels. Thus, there was a need to use solar trackers to raise the productivity of (PV) panels to the highest possible limit. In this paper, a practical study is conducted to determine the productivity of a fixed (PV) system and (PV) system with a solar tracker, then compare the results for both systems. This study is implemented for different days of the year and specified for the city of Mosul, located at a longitude of 43 degree and a latitude of 36 degree. The results show that the generated power of the tracking system is increased by 24 to 43 % compared with the fixed system in Mosul city.

articleTitle: Design and Construction of an Educational Corrosion Monitor System for Students at High Schools and Universities
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: This study aims to design an educational corrosion monitor system. The developed system gives the students the ability to study metal corrosion in an acidic media by following the emitted Hydrogen gas is produced from the acid that reacted with the metal. A Hydrogen gas sensor was used to measure the quantity of gas emitted. This sensor was connected to an Arduino-UNO microcontroller to convert the sensor's signal to digital values. The monitoring of the corrosion process can be followed by software programmed as Macro Unit and installed on Microsoft Excel. The Affected factors studied include the exposure time of metal in acid media, the producibility, and the system's response to the acceleration of emitted gas. The results indicate that the system has high accuracy. Also, this system is characterized as cheap (25$) to construct and is small, portable, and easy to operate, which gives the ability to study metal corrosion in education for high schools and universities.

articleTitle: Recognize Facial Emotion Using Landmark Technique in Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: Body language and facial expressions account for 60-65% of all communication, and researchers have used a landmark algorithm to extract features from images of the face. The algorithm identifies 68 points on the face and calculates the Euclidean distance between each point, creating a file of distances which is then used as input for a deep one-dimensional model. The resulting accuracy is 0.98.

articleTitle: IoT Based Vital Signs Monitoring with Fall Detection System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: As healthcare spending continues to rise, continuous monitoring in the home becomes increasingly critical for enhancing patient outcomes and lowering costs. Therefore, Vital signs monitor with a fall detection system based on IoT help to address this issue. The design and implementation of a Vital signs monitor system (VSMS) with fall detection (FD) system based on IoT (Blynk application) is presented in this paper. Various vital signs, including heart rate, the saturation of oxygen in the peripheral blood (SpO2), are measured by the designed system, which uses the MPU6050 sensor to detect falls. The collected data is transmitted to the Blynk application for visualization and analysis. Continuous monitoring of vital signs and fall detection, which is crucial for elderly and chronically ill patients, is provided by the proposed system. The results showed that the proposed FDs were successful in monitoring the vital signs of elderly patients with a fall detection accuracy of 93.4%. The healthcare sector is rapidly transformed by the Internet of Things (IoT) enabling continuous monitoring of patients' health conditions, with vital signs monitoring and fall detection systems being two important applications of IoT in healthcare.

articleTitle: FEM Analytical Model for Efficiency Improvement of Submersible Pump
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: This paper involves modeling and simulating a real submersible pump powered by a three-phase induction motor (3PIM) to examine its transient and steady-state properties, such as its torque-speed, torque-time, speed-time characteristics, and its rotor and stator currents characteristics, etc. To improve the motor characteristics, the motor's properties can be precisely predicted using computer software. A class D 15KW three-phase squirrel cage induction motor has been examined and modeled using Ansys Electromagnetics 2022R1-Maxwell 2D. improving the efficiency and torque of the submersible induction motors is studied using the parametric technique, and the effect of changing design parameters such as rotor bars dimension, Slots dimension, air gap length, and stack length has been investigated. The parametric variation resulted in an increase in efficiency by 2.3%, and the rated torque increased by 3.4 N.m.

articleTitle: Effects of Different Vaccines on Genetic Immune and Antibody Response Using Machine Learning methods
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: Machine learning models have shown promising results in analyzing genetic, immune, and antibody responses to vaccines. Studies have identified certain genes consistently activated in individuals with a robust immune response to the flu vaccine, and specific antibodies most effective in preventing infection. In a recent study using a dataset of 161 blood samples from individuals who received the BNT162b2 and ChAdOx1 vaccines, machine learning algorithms accurately predicted vaccine efficacy based on genetic, immune, and antibody responses. The AdaBoost model had the highest accuracy at 98.9%, followed by the Decision Tree model at 93.8%, and k-Nearest Neighbors at 87.7%. The AdaBoost model also performed the best overall, with the highest precision and recall for both vaccines.

articleTitle: Design of Induction Coils for Portable Brazing Induction Furnace
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: This paper deals with an induction furnace especially designed, analyzed, and implemented to work as a portable device used to perform brazing copper tubes and repair copper parts operations on site. Hence, it must be flexible, compatible, and able to concentrate the changing magnetic flux on the required position to shorten the brazing time and avoid transferring thermal effects to unrequired positions. The design is intended to maximize the power transfer to the load and reduces the losses that occur in the furnace power supply. These requirements are approved, and the practical results agree with the simulation.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of a High Gain Microstrip Patch Antenna for 5G Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: Fifth-generation wireless communications (5G) have become an urgent need for everyone, especially using millimeter-wave. Millimeter-wave requires a high-frequency range and high gain. It is proposed to design and simulate a microstrip patch antenna (MSPA) to achieve this goal. MSPA operates at a frequency of 28 GHz with a gain of 9.963 dBi. The proposed MSPA has small dimensions (3.8 × 5.2 × 0.94) mm. Copper is used as the ground plane and the patch antenna layers, while the insulating layer is Rogers RT5880 (lossy). The simulation results showed that the value of the voltage standing wave ratio (VSWR) is 1.146, the half power beamwidth (HPBW) value is equal to 86o, the directivity is 9.916, and the return loss is −23.29 dB. This small antenna design can be significant for Millimeter-wave applications in mobile devices and multi-antenna environments such as massive multi-input multi-output (mMIMO).

articleTitle: Calculation System Design for Carbon Dioxide Emissions Grid-connected Photovoltaic System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: With rising energy demand, the world is looking for new ways to generate electricity utilizing ecologically benign technologies such as solar, wind, and hydropower. In this paper, a PV model is designed and implemented for an on-grid solar system with six panels, each with a capacity of 50 watts. A circuit was also constructed to calculate the amount of CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>emission decrease and display the data on the LCD screen. When the model was run for five hours in a row, 1100 watts were obtained, with a grid lifetime emission of 955.9g CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/wh. This type of project with a high potential for clean and sustainable energy should be implemented.

articleTitle: Optimization of Induction Motor Rotor Bar Geometry Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: This paper presents a systematic optimal design algorithm for the shape of the rotor slot to get optimal operating torque and efficiency in a three-phase squirrel cage induction motor (SCIM). The determination of the ideal dimensions of the rotor bar is carried out with a multi-objective genetic algorithm (MOGA). The primary purpose is to enhance induction motors' performance and verify the predicted results with analytical calculations. Maxwell Ansys 2D has implemented the parametrical method for modeling the SCIM, and the result shows an increasing ratio of the starting torque by (22.35<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>), as well as the efficiency by (6.67%) and a reducing ripple torque by (34.68%).

articleTitle: Fire Recognition Using EfficientNet and ResNet 50
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: Desertification is mainly brought on by forest fires, which also have catastrophic effects on ecosystems supporting agriculture and forests. Modern fire detection and warning systems use many methods, including satellite monitoring, sensor networks, image processing, data fusion, and more. Researchers have been interested in fire detection for the past ten years because of the severe harm that fires can do to people and property in a short amount of time. Fire is very contagious and dangerous. As a result, the fire detection system's response time is crucial. The use of deep learning algorithms coupled with cameras to monitor and identify fires is one of the contemporary approaches to fire detection. Using the gathered data set, the machine could locate the fires. With a classification accuracy of (99.67<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>), the deep learning transmission network approach (Efficient Net) was successful and the (Resnet50) network algorithm approach was used to ensure the accuracy of the categorization is achieved to (99. 88<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>).

articleTitle: Performance Comparison Among Different Chirping Methods of Fiber Bragg Grating for Dispersion Compensation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: In this paper, different Fiber Bragg Grating chirping methods are compared. Fiber Bragg Grating, which is a well-known dispersion compensation component, is utilized to propose a new system model for dispersion compensation. It has been used with the Tanh apodization function and different chirp functions to provide a Chirped Fiber Bragg Grating. In addition, a low-pass Gaussian filter is added to the model to enhance its performance in terms of Q-factor, BER, and eye diagram. The comparison is made via Optisystem, whereas some results were analyzed via Python. Simulation and analytical results confirm that the Q-factor, BER, and eye diagrams of the proposed system with linear chirping show superior performance compared to other chirpings for 28km and more fiber lengths. The values of Max Q-factor and Min-BER with 40km fiber length were 29.5524 and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{9.3407}^{\ast}\mathbf{10}^{\wedge}-\mathbf{182}$</tex> for the proposed system with linear chirping, 26.897 and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{5.410}^{\ast}\mathbf{10}^{\wedge}-\mathbf{135}$</tex> with quadratic chirping, 25.263 and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{3.531}^{\ast}\mathbf{10}^{\wedge}$</tex>- 141 with square root chirping, and 22.582 and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{5.236}^{\ast} \mathbf{10}^{\wedge}$</tex>- 105with cubic root chirping. Finally, as 40km is the maximum link length proposed between Base-Stations and Base-Band Unit pool in C-RAN 5G networks, therefore linear chirping is the best candidate compared to other methods.

articleTitle: Improvement of Protection Factor for a Controlled Laboratory Computer Network Using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: Computer networks provide exceptional privacy, primarily for testing and other educational activities. However, the security of computer networks is an exceptionally touchy subject, mainly when applied in labs and tests for educational purposes. Any software system created on a server typically requires a username and password to access a collection of computers on a particular network. The proposed work devised and implemented a neural network feedback network with four inputs (I.P. address, MAC address, user number, and time) and an output that represents the user's acceptance or rejection. A few instances of the data and numbers needed to train the neural network include the lab's address, the student's name, the academic stage's address, etc. Good results were obtained through the company's training and education, which was tested on more than 200 models, and the response aligned with the data. No user can access the network without first being recognized by the proposed network by comparing the pre-trained data to ensure they are authorized to take the exam or enter for any other reason.

articleTitle: On the Location Accuracy of the Multi-Antenna GPS
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: Despite the significant improvements in signal processing techniques currently in use, GPS receivers still encounter significant obstacles, like multipath, that continues to be a primary source of range inaccuracy. GPS multipath affects the acquisition and tracking components inside the receiver, resulting in inaccurate readings or a loss of GPS satellite signal lock. As a result, accurate location and velocity cannot be obtained from GPS devices. The main objective of this research is to enhance the performance of the GPS system by reducing the effect of multipath on the accuracy of vehicle's location determination. In this paper, a vehicle tracking system that is based on multi antenna sensors module is proposed to increase the accuracy of vehicle location. The proposed system uses the Arduino Mega board as microcontrollers and low-cost global positioning system sensor. Under the suggested microcontroller, the performance of the proposed GPS system in determining the precision of vehicle location, is investigated for different speeds at different locations. The minimum and maximum location accuracy results are 2.69 and 31.39 meters at speeds of 0 and 100 Km/h respectively. The findings displays that the proposed system can operate in any weather and offer more precise real-time object position.

articleTitle: Infrared-Based Non-Invasive Blood Glucose Measurement and Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: Diabetes is a commonly observed long-term health condition in a significant number of countries worldwide. The most popular technique for measuring glucose levels in the blood is costly invasive and dangerous. It poses significant risk for transmission of infections. On a long-term basis, the invasive approach damages finger tissues. Instead, the noninvasive approach may be used to enable frequent testing and to stop the pain caused by repeated finger pricks. This paper describes the development of a non-invasive, portable device that uses an infrared sensor to measure glucose levels in the blood. The fluctuations in the intensity of near-infrared (NIR) light received by the photodetector as it passes through the fingertip of 54 individuals diagnosed with diabetes (aged 18–70) are utilized to ascertain the glucose concentration in their blood. The measured glucose levels are then displayed on an LCD screen. The proposed system is also capable of communicating via Wi-Fi with an Android application installed on a mobile phone for displaying and saving data. In comparison to the conventional invasive finger-prick method, the proposed system exhibits noteworthy outcomes and a high level of accuracy.

articleTitle: DC Motor Speed/Torque Estimation and Control Based on Transfer Function Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: Three-phase bridge controlled rectifier is used in this paper to regulate the speed of a separately excited DC motor (SEDCM). A controller based on a neural network-PI controller is built to get the required angles for trig thyristors to control the speed of SEDCM at desired values. The speed of the SEDCM is estimated depending on transfer function characteristics using the direct output voltage/current of the AC/DC converter, which is designed, evaluated and modeled by Matlab\Simulink. The SEDCM drive system is tested under different conditions of speed/torque in steady-state and dynamic situations. The simulation results explain the success of the designed controller system. The speed/torque responses have a fast active response and adequate identity concerning the actual, estimated and required values.

articleTitle: Recognition of Breast Tumor by Ultrasound Imaging Based on Deep Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: The leading cause of death for women worldwide is considered to be breast cancer. To prevent death, early discovery is crucial. The pre-trained Alexnet model in this research is trained using an ultrasound image dataset. The Model was already trained using various types of images, which will increase the effectiveness of the training process. Before training, there is no preprocessing of the image. Unsupervised training is the name for this type of training methodology. It was 90.5% accurate on average. The pre-training model and unsupervised training method are two potential approaches that are taken into consideration.

articleTitle: Internet-Based Smartphone System for After-Stroke Hand Rehabilitation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: Hand rehabilitation for after-stroke survived patients is crucial to be initiated very soon for good results in the recovery process. Traditional rehabilitation requires clinical supervision by a physiotherapist, so it can be costly, time consuming, and demotivating. This research suggests a low-cost online wearable hand rehabilitation system to support partially disabled patients with their hand rehabilitation. The proposed online system consists of two main parts, namely patient part, and therapist part. The patient part consists of a mobile phone app. and a Myo gesture control armband. The app. generates rehabilitation exercises and all other operations to help the patients do their exercises on their own with motivating graphics. Meanwhile, the Myo armband detects electromyographic (EMG) signals of patient's arm muscles and recognizes the gestures and movements of the hand. The system can classify these gestures and movements for correct and incorrect to track the patient's performance. On the other hand, the therapist part includes local performance and remote online monitoring portal for monitoring, analysis, and assessment of the patient's recovery progress. After completion of a given exercise, a performance report of the patient will be given locally and sent to the monitoring portal for assessment by the physiotherapist. The system was tested by healthy subjects to prove its efficiency with accuracy of 96.9%. The results showed a smooth performance and compatibility between the main two parts of the system.

articleTitle: Design Off-Grid Solar Water Pumping System as a Replacement to Petrol Pump in Remote Area
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: The water and electricity sectors in Iraq have been a victim to many challenges after 2003. Such as the insufficiency of available generation systems, and their declining years. While, the challenges of water sector lie in the lack of rain and sources of Iraq's rivers that are controlled by neighboring countries for not respecting international treaties. Thus, Iraqis farmers are forced to use the wells for compensating the scarcity of water. To overcome the problem of withdrawing water from wells at different depth and to avoid problems of traditional fuel pumps, Solar Water Pumping System (SWPS) considered one of the options due to environmentally friendly, less maintenance, simple installation with no moving parts. This paper presents idea of designing a (SWPS) as an alternative to petrol pump for irrigating small farms in Diyala and take in consideration simplicity and the cost. discussed the performance of the SWPS under the influence of solar irradiance and ambient temperature and represented as a power production. Furthermore, calculating the economic cost of the two pumping systems. The results showed that the maximum value of water flow rate recorded 3.11m3/h at 12:00pm, with average output power 935.08W, 900.4W for DC and AC respectively. The economic results showed low cost of power generating during the day with 0.032$ per kWh.

articleTitle: High Impedance Fault Detection in Distribution Feeder Based on Maximum Overlap Discrete Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: High Impedance Faults (HIFs) represent a common category of faults in distribution networks. These faults occur when power lines come into contact with high-resistance surfaces. Unlike other types of faults, HIFs exhibit unique characteristics such as non-linearity, asymmetry, randomness, and relatively low fault current levels compared to the feeder load current. It is important to note that the low current magnitude of HIFs poses a significant challenge for traditional protection devices in detecting and distinguishing these faults. This study aims to develop an effective approach for detecting HIFs in distribution feeders by extracting features from the current signal at the substation bus. The Maximum Overlap Discrete Wavelet Transform (MODWT) is utilized in this paper as a current signal decomposition technique. This is followed by reconstructing a signal from the appropriate coefficients, which is used to extract features. These features are then employed as input to the Artificial Neural Network (ANN) for distinguishing HIF events from non-HIF events in the distribution system, such as capacitor bank switching, linear and non-linear load switching, and transformer energization. After conducting rigorous testing under various fault and non-fault event scenarios within a radial power feeder system, the proposed technique has proven to be reliable, robust, and effective for HIF detection, with a high accuracy rate of 99.2%.

articleTitle: Numerical and Statistical Analysis on Polymeric Lattice Structures via Taghuchi Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: The manufacturing of lightweight and complex geometric lattice structures is now possible adopting additive manufacturing (AM) which was previously unattainable via traditional manufacturing techniques. The main purpose of this investigation is to analysis three different lattice structures namely simple cubic (SC), simple cubic body center cubic (SC-BCC), face center cubic (FCC) adopting three different fused deposition modelling (FDM) printed filaments. The investigation is conducted using a commercial finite element code ABAQUS. The considered filaments are polylactic acid (PLA), acrylonitrile butadiene styrene (ABS) and nylon. In addition to this, the effect of lattice strut diameter is also investigated. The design of the experiment is performed adopting Minitab-19 and the numerical validation is performed against the results found in the literature. After conducting compression tests, three different outcomes, namely, modulus of elasticity (E), effective strength (ES) and surface area (A) are calculated. The outcomes are further analyzed in the data analysis software to compare and investigate the effectiveness of each parameter. Three different data analysis methods such as analysis of variance (ANOVA), main effect plot analysis and contour graph analysis are employed. Each analysis revealed that the strut diameter has a remarkable influence on E, ES and A. Moreover, the mechanical performance of PLA filament and SC-BCC lattice is better than other considered filaments and lattice structures.

articleTitle: Review of Recent Development in EMG Signal Classification Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: Characterizing electromyographic (EMG) signals is essential in diagnosing neuromuscular diseases. Different classifiers have been developed to build accurate and highly efficient EMG signal characterization algorithms. This paper reviews some classification approaches used in EMG characterization and discusses the most recent achievements in this field, emphasizing neuromuscular disease. The methods studied are classified according to their methodology, and a synopsis of the significant findings related to each way is provided. Surface EMG is recently more relative to signal processing and artificial intelligence for moving organs. On the other hand, traditional EMG is under the scope of surgical cases by following different algorithms. The specified algorithm is our interest to start work from the endpoint of a light spot like Wavelet Transform (WT), Discrete Fourier transform (DFT), Higher order statistics (HOS), Artificial Neural Network (ANN), Fuzzy Logic (FL), Empirical Mode Decomposition (EMD), Independent Component Analysis (ICA), Principle Component Analysis (PCA) and Autoregressive (AR).

articleTitle: Real-Time Monitoring Mosul Water Supply
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: UN studies show Iraq is the fifth country most prone to desertification. The Nineveh Water Directorate, which distributes water to the populace, faces several challenges. However, the drying up of the Tigris River, which flows through the governorate of Nineveh, is the biggest. All of this harmed the pumping and processing of water in the clean water distribution networks that supply the residents of Mosul city. The technology under consideration keeps track of how much pure water is pumped by the water booster stations directly linked to the water supply system for residential areas. Connecting the measuring instruments to the Arduino UNO, GSM SIM900, and current-to-volt converter will allow the reading of measuring values from the devices. A Data SIM card was used, and a private network was devoted to the Nineveh Water Directorate using an access point name (APN) for data transfer. The communication network uses SIM cards fitted with Asiacell company for Cellular Communications. Data is transferred and stored on a computer using the Softwareserial Arduino library. All stations in the city will eventually be connected to this system since the results of the planned system's monitoring of the quantity of water pushed are regarded as positive and encouraging. So that monitoring in these stations will be automated, contemporary, and free from the outdated regular practices that interfere with the equitable water distribution to the populace.

articleTitle: Accuracy Evaluation of Healthcare Monitoring System Based on ESP32 Microcontroller with IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: The use of Internet of Things (IoT) technologies in healthcare has gained significant attention in recent years due to the potential to improve the management of chronic conditions and enhance the overall quality of life for elderly individuals. In this research, a healthcare monitoring system using an ESP32 microcontroller with Wi-Fi (802.11n) technology is proposed. Various sensors, including an ECG sensor, pulse oximeter sensor, and temperature sensor are used in this system, for the continuous monitoring of physiological parameters, the acquired data is transmitted to the healthcare providers in real-time. Also, the performance of this system is investigated for the accuracy of the measured parameters. The obtained average accuracy values for temperature, heart rate and SpO2 are 97.32%, 96.94% and 98.9% respectively. The proposed system was tested for to elderly individuals, and the results showed that the system was feasible and effective in monitoring physiological parameters and transmitting the data in real-time. The proposed system has the potential to improve the management of chronic conditions and enhance the overall quality of life for elderly individuals.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of a Seven-Phase Induction Motor
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: This paper provides a generalized model of a multi-phase induction motor drive using MATLAB/Simulink. Induction motors with a stator that contain phases greater than three are defined as multiphase motors. Since they have a higher torque density are more efficient than traditional three-phase drives, and can start and operate even in the presence of a phase open fault, multiphase motor drives such as seven-phase induction motor (SPIM) have gained more attention in recent years. This paper presents mathematical modeling of SPIM using MATLAB/Simulink environment. To assess the effectiveness of the developed SPIM model, a simulation study is conducted when the motor model is energized from a seven-phase voltage source inverter. The simulation results are presented under varying load conditions. The speed change is monitored by the system's torques, and the system's response to emergency changes is observed and calculated.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Real Time Diabetes Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: In the modern era, diabetes is one of a group of common diseases that affect people of different age groups, as diabetics suffer from the possibility of developing many heart diseases. This results in chest pain, which is known as angina pectoris, heart attacks, and stroke, as well as narrowing and hardening of the arteries. In this paper, a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) type algorithm is proposed to detect diabetes by skin color, and characterizing the disease by RGB skin image. Several morphological operations were performed by shining laser light in colors (White, Green, and Red) on the skin to detect and extract features. Using a data set that was collected from patients with diabetes, the patients were divided into four categories to determine the percentage of high diabetes in the patient. An algorithm in the classification model for diabetes has achieved that the white led light channel has a largely excellent performance in classifying diabetic patients with a typical accuracy value of (92.24%) and the green led light with accuracy value of (81.12 %) and the red led light achieved an accuracy of (79.31%). Because of the limited penetration depth of the white led light channel in skin tissue, the blue channel is more effective compared to other channels such as green and red channels.

articleTitle: Case Study of sustainability on Properties of Reinforced Concrete Beams Containing Silica Fume with Polypropylene Fibers
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: The qualities confirmed in this study include silica fume content (0%, 10%, and 20%) by replacing equivalent weight of cement in concrete. By volume fraction of concrete, polypropylene fibers were included in the mix. (0 percent, 0.20 percent, and 0.40 percent). Three deep specimens of reinforced concrete beams were evaluated, it measures (100×300) mm in cross-section and 1000 mm in length. Three beams are preliminary based on the relationship between shear span (a) and depth (d). The ratio (a/d) was discarded (1), by varied holding polypropylene fibers with silica fume varying percentages of substitute for different polypropylene fibers and silica fume product from recycling, it is attained from the smoke expanding through the chimneys of the furnaces by the condensation progression, were added from volume fraction, the (a/d) ratio was employed. The experimental test results improved concrete properties and enhanced the general behavior for substantial crack in reinforced concrete beams pattern when, load-deflection, also strains were explored. The finite element model (ABAQUS -version19) employed is capable of imitating in this study the behavior of externally containing silica fume with polypropylene fibers beams failed in shear.

articleTitle: Intelligent Energy Management Technique for Hybrid PV/PEMFC/Battery System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: A new method for controlling direct current electrical level converter to another is presented in this study. Which connects a fuel cell system to the direct current bus of a PV power system. By operating in continuous charging mode, the adapter will extend battery life. Therefore, the FC power produced considering the balance of power flows on the DC bus is used to compensate for the fluctuation of the PV power and load demand. As a result of its ability to demand, the system provides an unloading load. The system contains maximum power point tracking, converters, and other components to optimize the power gathered from the PV array. Basic system parameters, such as the battery's charge status and the AC current, are controlled using the conventional integrated proportional control approach. It was built in MATLAB/Simulink for system study and control. The focus of this research is on proposing an intelligent energy management technique to control power distribution in a stand-alone hybrid PV/PEMFC/battery power system.

articleTitle: Back-Stepping Based Flux Orientation Control of a Five-Phase Induction Motor
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: Five-phase induction motors are considered an alternative and effective solution for industrial applications with high electric power, as they are beginning to replace three-phase motors. Both types are similar in terms of working principle and control methods. The flux-oriented control (FOC) methodology is commonly used to separate torque control from flux control. As the main objective of this methodology is to maintain a constant value flux in the electrical machine. Based on this concept, this paper presents a back-stepping control methodology based on FOC for driving a five-phase induction motor. The control system includes two regulating loops. In the outer loop, speed, and flux components are regulated. Then, the reference values of the currents in (abcde) frame are calculated by Park transform. The currents in the inner loop are regulated using hysteresis regulators to obtain the pulses to be applied to the voltage inverter. The simulation results in MATLAB \ Simulink show the effectiveness of the proposed methodology compared to the PI controllers-based FOC system, as it has high dynamic performance and fast response, and maintains flux at the nominal value despite the change in the rotor resistance value, while it was observed that the flux increased by 8% When using a FOC system based on PI controllers

articleTitle: Big Data Framework for Monitoring Real-Time Vehicular Traffic Flow
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: The relatively high rate of traffic accidents in Iraq shows the necessity of working on the driver's actions monitoring through the use of vehicle flow data to improve the road safety. Based on this situation, many tools and technologies such as sensors, cameras, and data management can be utilized to monitor traffic conditions and provide real-time information to drivers and transportation authorities. The primary challenges are collecting, processing, analyzing, and visualizing the huge volume of data produced by vehicles and devices. To address these challenges, we proposed and implemented a big data framework for monitoring the data flows generated by vehicles in the city environment. Among the various data generated by vehicles, our framework monitors the latitude and longitude values of the global positioning system (GPS) and speed. The framework's architecture is scalable and fault-tolerant which makes it suitable for handling large-scale data flows generated by many connected vehicles. The results show that it allows for increased throughput, high availability, and fault tolerance and provides full-text search. This framework has been implemented using several big data platforms and tools such as Apache Kafka and Elasticsearch. In addition, the framework's services have been packaged in the container-based virtualization environment to support the reusability and portability of the framework.

articleTitle: Partially Double-Pass Structure in Serial Hybrid Fiber Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: In this paper, a partially double pass configuration in serial hybrid fiber amplifier is experimentally demonstrated. In the proposed design, a double pass erbium gain and single pass Raman gain are achieved serially. A total pump power of 450 mW (400 mW for 1495 nm Raman amplifier and 50 mW for1480 nm in erbium amplifier) were used. At -30 dBm input signal power and optimum pumps conditions, the achieved flatness bandwidth is 80 nm (1530–1610 nm) in the conventional and long bands (C+L) bands. In addition, the obtained average gain level is 33 dB. While the obtained flatness gain is 85 nm (1525–1610 nm) within the large input signal power region at -5 dBm. By choosing a proper pump wavelength that avoid the overlapping between Raman and erbium peaks gain, a wide flatness gain is obtained.

Author Keywords: Partially Double-Pass Serial Hybrid Fiber Amplifier

articleTitle: Hybrid Photovoltaic-Pumped Storage Hydro System for Electric Energy Production Improvement (Mosul Dam Case Study)
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: The goal of this study is to create an on-grid hybrid power system using PV and hydro pumped storage systems to enhance energy production of Mosul Dam Pumped Storage Power Plant and cover the energy consumption of the hydro power plant in Mosul Dam. The production data of the plant showed that the plant's production is 137.196 GWh/year and the plant's consumption data showed that the plant's consumption is 184.913 GWh/year, implying that, the average consumption of the plant is 47.717 GWh/year. To reduce consumption as minimum as possible an on-grid PV power plant of 100 MW capacity is assumed to be constructed over the lake of Mosul Dam, with the produced energy of the plant is directly injected into the grid during peak load periods and utilized to pump water to the upper reservoir during off-peak periods. The results showed that the produced energy of the PV plant can fill the upper reservoir 104 times per year producing 150 GWh/year, so the consumed energy of the hydro pumped storage plant will be supplied from renewable energy source, leading to a reduction in the cost of the consumed energy, as well as, a reduction in the cost of the photovoltaic plant, due to the lack of the need to use batteries, which are usually expensive, limited in capacity, and short life.

articleTitle: COVID-19 Detection Based on Chest X-Rays and CT Scans Using Inception v3 Deep Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: In December 2019, a number of acute atypical respiratory ailment cases were recorded in Wuhan, China. This swiftly swept throughout China from Wuhan. It wasn't long before a novel coronavirus was identified as the culprit. Among the types of machine learning is deep learning, Deep learning algorithms are designed to automatically learn from large amounts of data, by iteratively improving their ability to identify and extract meaningful features from input data. The majority of COVID-19 symptoms include indicators of respiratory infections and lung abnormalities that radiologists may identify. As a result, Deep Learning algorithms may be used to diagnose illness from pictures of the CT scan and the chest X-ray. To assist radiologists, automated programs might be designed. This article is an effort to diagnose the sickness using the Deep Learning algorithm Inception V3. The method was tested on two types of databases: X-rays of the chest and CT scans. The results demonstrated that the procedure was successful and that the results were improved when applied to the Chest X-ray datasets.

articleTitle: IoT-Based Real Time Data Acquisition of PV Panel
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: Renewable energy is becoming more popular because of the world's increasing demand for electricity as a result of rising energy consumption and the depletion of traditional energy sources. The most important and most efficient of these is solar energy, and to get the maximum value of this energy with the highest efficiency, there should be direct monitoring of the performance of these solar panels. So, in this work, a data acquisition system for a PV panel using a Programmable Logic Controller was proposed and implemented, and the collected data was remotely monitored based on the Internet of Things (IoT). The proposed PV monitoring system, which consists of a PV panel, various sensors, a PLC (a Siemens S7-1200 type), and a load, was experimentally tested in Kirkuk City for approximately 10 hours to visualize the five parameters of PV terminal voltage, load current, power, temperature, and radiation. Three visualization methods were employed for presenting the results: The first, locally direct method, is in SIMATIC WinCC on the computer. The second method is that the collected data was saved in Excel file format. The final and most important technique is smart online wireless remote monitoring on the Ubidots platform, which utilizes the router unit to display the parameters on the smart device. The proposed system has a low price, a simple design, real-time measurements, the ability to be expanded, high efficiency, accuracy, and reliability, and can be built quickly.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of Natural Fiber Reinforced Hybrid Composite RVE: A Finite Element Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: In recent times, hybrid composite from natural fibers has drawn significant attention in the composite industry due to better mechanical properties, lower manufacturing costs, biodegradability and recyclability behavior of natural fibers. In computational micromechanics RVE (representative volume element) generation is a well-known technique to compute the mechanical properties. This study aims to investigate the impact of fiber volume fraction, fiber diameter and fiber length in a hybrid composite RVE through FEM (finite element method) analysis with an additional tool namely ABAQUS easy PBC plugin, in which jute and sisal are considered with an epoxy matrix. Hybridization ratio in jute fiber and sisal fiber is kept as 1:1. To compute and demonstrate the mechanical properties in hybrid composite RVE, three responses such as longitudinal young's modulus (E<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf>), in-plane shear modulus (G<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</inf>) and major poison's ratio (v<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</inf>) are considered. Validation of this research is obtained from available literature. The design of the experiment and different statistical analysis are made through response surface methodology on considered parameters and responses (E<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf>, G<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</inf>, v<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</inf>). The statistical and FEM analysis reveals that fiber volume fraction is the most crucial parameter for hybrid composite RVE.

articleTitle: The Application of ANFIS to Prediction of the Amount of Emissions from an Emitter Activity to Reduce Climate Change
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: Understanding the links between C02 emissions from fuel consumption and climate change may assist countries in determining the amount of C02 or C02 equivalent emissions, and act accordingly by reformulating new energy policies to reduce emissions and achieve sustainable development. This understanding can help guide countries in developing better energy policies that are designed to reduce C02 and equivalent emissions, while still promoting economic growth and development. To reach the global climate goals set by the United Nations [25], countries must take decisive action to reduce emissions from fuel consumption and energy production while promoting clean energy, which can help mitigate the effects of climate change. Understanding the magnitude of the emissions problem is necessary before coming up with innovative, long-lasting solutions to better comprehend the issue of emissions. An important first step in achieving this understanding is to accurately assess the current levels of emissions from fuel consumption and energy production in a certain country and analyze the amount of these emissions and finally implement strategies to reduce them. Using machine learning technologies such as predictive analytics, and artificial intelligence can help create meaningful insights into the data to understand patterns in emissions that could enable better strategies for reducing emissions. Using a dataset that belongs to the Canadian government, with input data including engine size, number of cylinders, and fuel consumption, an ANFIS model was created to predict emissions. The amount of emissions represents the output. A variety of membership functions were tested in order to gain the best results. Another dataset was generated by applying the Extra-Trees regressor algorithm to the mentioned dataset and retraining the ANFIS model using the generated dataset to achieve better results. The resulting model can then serve as a trustworthy tool to support the application of efficient mitigation strategies and to inform and help policymakers.

articleTitle: Improved Chaotic Aquila Optimization Algorithm Based on Artificial Hummingbird Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: The widespread presence of organisms in nature and their unique ways of obtaining nourishment has piqued the curiosity of scientists, leading them to create mathematical models that mimic these organisms. These models have found applications in resolving math problems that are typically challenging and require substantial effort to solve. However, these models may have limitations and may require modifications to enhance their performance. In this study, two methods were employed to ache the optimal solution. The initial phase involved utilizing The Aquila Optimization Algorithm (AO) in combination with the chaos function and chaotic tent function to obtain the optimal solution. This phase served as the foundation of the work. Subsequently, the first phase was further refined by incorporating the artificial hummingbird algorithm (AHA) into the model. This hybridization process entailed integrating communities and equations, and the optimal solution was obtained by performing 1000 iterations in both phases. The research was carried out using MATLAB 2021 as the software platform, providing a robust framework for implementing and evaluating the proposed methods.

articleTitle: A Review of the Security Challenges Mitigation in IoT Systems Via the Utilization of SDN Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: The emergence of the Internet of Things (IoT) has led to an increase in data streams, requiring new network architectures that can accommodate the mass number of connected devices. However, the heterogeneity and security issues of IoT devices pose significant challenges to network infrastructure. Software-defined networking (SDN) has emerged as a promising solution to mitigate IoT challenges. This paper presents an overview of the challenges facing IoT networks and the use of SDN as an emerging technology to address these challenges. The study suggests the use of secured SDN for IoT systems and recommends the use of AI-based intrusion detection and deep learning structures to enhance security

articleTitle: Total Remediation of NRC Oily Sludge Using Hydrothermal Carbonization for Hydro char Production
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: The feasibility of using hydrothermal carbonization (HTC) to remediate hazardous the oily sludge (OS) and generate a renewable solid carbon fuel and hydrochar was investigated in this study. The approach involves heating the oily OS at 105 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${}^{\circ}\mathbf{C}$</tex> for 24 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$h$</tex>. The operating parameters affecting the production of hydrochar from OS by HTC at a 10 g feed amount and 3 MPa N2 of pressure (range of the temperature was 150 - 210 °C, and range of the residence time was 30 - 90 min) were investigated and optimized. Qualified studies of energy properties for the production hydrochar were investigated by higher heating values (HHV), element composition, ultimate analysis, and energy recovery of hydrochar produced were explored. The results showed that the best hydrochar produced by a range of temperature at 190 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${}^{\circ}\mathbf{C}$</tex> (labeled as HTC@190) achieved the highest HHV of 14.21 MJ/kg, while the best hydrochar produced by a range of residence time at 60 min (labeled as HTC@75) achieved highest HHV of 14.78 MJ/kg. The energy recovery of HTC@190, and HTC @75 is 14.8, and 15.4, respectively. The result clarified that hydrochar produced from OS by HTC ways could be used for energy generation as a solid carbon fuel and for environmental protection.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of an Automated Production Plant and Warehouse Management System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: This paper illustrates the implementation of a practical model that can simulate one of the applications in modern industries while also displaying the results remotely. Moreover, three steps of the automation pyramid have been achieved, starting from the field level and ending with the supervisory level (SCADA), which allows us to catch up with the fourth industrial revolution that is trending. The article can be summarized into three sections. The first one is about building a virtual automated warehouse system that utilizes a conveyor and a PLC to control the production line. The simulation of these processes has been implemented via the Factory I/O platform. It is subdivided into four subcategories: color-based sorting, material-based sorting, box size-based sorting, and packaging optimization. The Human-Machine Interface (HMI) design is also discussed, which optimizes stock requests. The second aspect of this paper focuses on practical work, specifically sorting by size. It also explores the use of pneumatic cylinders in separating boxes based on different dimensions. These cylinders are actuated through solenoid valves, which receive instructions from sensors and transmit signals to the PLC for efficient control. Finally, the Internet of Things (IoT) has a share in this project, which allows remote monitoring of the production line to increase safety and efficiency.

articleTitle: Study on Blockchain Scalability Methods Limitation and Solution
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: Blockchain technology is quickly becoming the most transformative technology of recent times. It has also generated optimism and hype, obtaining more attention from personal and general sections. Blockchain has a lot of great attributes, like anonymity, automation, trust-freeness, safety, democracy, transparency, and decentralization. Despite the good attributes, scalability is the main barrier, while the technology of Blockchain is widely applied in actual business areas. In coping with the increasing number of transactions, users, technology, and miners cannot scale as well and present similar performance as the centralized systems. So, in this paper, we analyze techniques with different effects to solve this issue. Additionally, we compared various techniques and listed potential directions to solve the blockchain scalability problem. However, wide-ranging blockchain scalability solutions exist to fully overcome that, which needs further research and more scalability solutions.

articleTitle: Enhancing Lives with Brain-Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: Enhancing Lives with Brain-Robot Interfaces for Elderly and Disabled Individuals.” This seminar illuminates the transformative potential of Brain-Robot Interfaces (BRIs) in empowering and aiding elderly and disabled individuals. Immerse yourself in the realm of neuro-assistive technologies as we explore the seamless integration of human cognition and robotic systems. Discover how BRIs can revolutionize daily activities, rehabilitation, and mobility for individuals with physical limitations. Gain valuable insights into the latest advancements, such as neuroprosthetics, exoskeletons, and brain-controlled robotic devices, designed to restore independence, improve quality of life, and unlock new possibilities for those in need. (Karam)

articleTitle: Future Mobile Communication Technologies: Requirements, Targets, Applications, and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering, Science and Advanced Technology (ICESAT)
abstract: Future mobile communication technologies involve 6G mobile network is aiming to establish new standards to fulfil unreachable performance requirements by the 5G mobile networks. This is due to the high requirements for more intelligent network, ultra-lower latency, extreme network communication speed, and supporting massive number of various connected applications. Motivated by the development of applications in massive connections, future networks, developments, and technological advancements for mobile communications should undergoes many challenges. In this context, highly immersive applications are demanded, such as 3D communications, massive extended reality (XR)/virtual reality (VR) applications, smart cities, and many more. Therefore, it was expected that the upcoming 6G networks will be capable of running extremely high-performance connectivity with massive numbers of connected devices, even under extreme density, diverse mobility, and energetic environments.
